scope: Exact gallery trajectories: first 15 targets from autonomous rollout, then rolling 16-step forecasts. Median metrics weight physical configurations equally, average replicas. Initial 32-second ramp and later refreshed forecasts are mixed as in display. Undershoot is max positive(truth-prediction) / whole-history abs truth peak, not pointwise percentage. Post-hoc associations, no causal claims; marginal groups confounded. No smoothing or modeling changes.

axis_checks.note: Renderer scales against all four series even when comparison lines are off. Ratio compares simulation+enabled model span with all-series span, before identical padding.
